title: ICAI Convocation September 2026: Over 9000 New CAs Join the Ranks!
content:
# ICAI Convocation September 2026: Over 9000 New CAs Join the Ranks!

Ek important update hai, especially for our newly qualified CAs and the entire fraternity. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne nation-wide convocation organize kiya hai.

*   The ICAI Convocation was successfully held on September 12, 2026, across 23 locations nationwide.
*   Around 9,000 newly qualified Chartered Accountants, including Rank Holders, were awarded their Certificate of Membership across India.
*   Specifically, in Chennai, 438 new Chartered Accountants were formally inducted into the profession.
*   The convocation aimed at formally welcoming members who enrolled with ICAI between May 1, 2026, and August 15, 2026.
